name: Attention Fusion
tagline: Project each observation modality to a shared embedding, then apply multi-head self-attention across the modality tokens.
diff_from_baseline: Standard cross-modal self-attention fusion (cf. Set Transformer / multimodal transformer). Lets the encoder learn pairwise modality interactions before flattening.

name: Gated Fusion
tagline: Each modality is processed by a small MLP and multiplied by a learned sigmoid gate from the same input; gated features concatenated.
diff_from_baseline: Highway / gated multimodal fusion (Arevalo et al. 2017, Hori et al. 2017). Lighter than attention but more expressive than concatenation; lets the policy down-weight noisy modalities per-channel.

name: Default (Concatenation)
tagline: Robomimic's default low-dim encoder: flatten and concatenate every observation modality vector.
diff_from_baseline: Mandlekar et al., Robomimic 2021 (CoRL). Default ObservationGroupEncoder behavior — concatenate raw low-dim modality vectors before the policy head; no learnable fusion parameters.
